name: work-lens
description: Summarizes each step of work into a one-line, collapsible, filterable entry: category, plan item, and a planned / new / fix marker.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Comma-separated work categories the summaries are sorted into.
categories.default: notes, backlog & artifacts, code, auditing, evaluating

neutralCategories.title: Neutral categories
neutralCategories.description: Comma-separated categories counted as neutral (gray): upkeep that adds no direct value. Fixes are negative (red); everything else is positive (green).

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that writes the summaries (each step is one small extra request, shown in /cost).

autoSummarize.title: Summarize automatically
autoSummarize.description: Off: nothing is sent until you run /worklog summarize.

collapseByDefault.title: Collapse steps by default
collapseByDefault.description: Fullscreen layout: a summarized step shows as its one-line header until you press it.

maxCalls.title: Call cap per session
maxCalls.description: Every model attempt counts, retries included.
